newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Sievert says dollar level acceptable.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Sievert says dollar level acceptable.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Olaf Sievert said on Thursday that the dollar had been at an acceptable level for some time.
"The dollar has been moving in an acceptable region now for some time; at the current level we do not see any risk for domestic price stability," he said in the text of a speech.
Sievert, also president of the state central bank for Saxony and Thuringia, was speaking at the bank's annual news conference.
